create_KimiK25Processor: create a KimiK25Processor instance with an image processor, tokenizer, and media token id
process_vision_chunks: process text and vision chunks through KimiK25Processor to produce input_ids and pixel_values
expand_media_tokens: expand placeholder media tokens in input_ids to the correct number of repeated media token ids
preprocess_vision_input: preprocess vision chunks with the image processor to extract pixel values and grid dimensions
tokenize_text_input: tokenize text input with the HfTokenizer and return BatchFeature with input_ids
